scripts.build: bun run build:gas && bun run build:web && bun run scripts/verify-dist.ts
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && bun run --cwd shared typecheck && bun run --cwd gas typecheck && bun run --cwd web typecheck
scripts.test: bun test ./scripts && bun run --cwd shared test && bun run --cwd gas test && bun run --cwd web test
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run test
scripts.push: bun run check && bun run build && bun run scripts/push.ts
scripts.deploy: bun run push && bun run scripts/deploy.ts
